Magnusson VDE screwdriver set for working on live electrical systems and components. The 12-piece mixed set includes slotted, Phillips and Pozidriv options in various sizes to cover most electrical work requirements. Manufactured from S2 steel with magnetised tips for secure fastening, each screwdriver features VDE insulation tested and rated to 1000V AC. Bi-material soft-grip handles deliver increased torque and control, with reduced hand strain during extended use.
